coming-soon-flips-a.summary: A coming soon teaser on tangerine and navy plates. Condensed cream or navy words hard cut one at a time, HOLD YOUR BREATH WHAT'S NEXT IS LANDING, each with a short bar growing under it, and the second BREATH stutters through serif, marker, brush and thin typefaces. text-rings-a.concept: The logo sits in a circle at the centre that draws itself on, then rings of the company name and a short tagline grow out of it one after another, spinning in alternate directions until the frame fills with a hypnotic vortex of type that eases to a stop and keeps turning. The eye stays pinned on the logo while the message multiplies outward; the copy is short, repeatable and confident.

Logo.hint: Logo: wide, square or round; it sits on a disc inside the drawn circle at the centre of the rings

Company Name.hint: The brand name repeated around every other ring, including the ring closest to the logo

Tagline.hint: A short repeatable phrase for the rings between the name rings, like a slogan or an offer

text-rings-a.summary: On black, the logo sits on a light disc from the first frame while a thin orange circle draws on around it. Once the circle closes, rings of the company name in bold white sans and a lowercase white tagline, split by small orange dots, grow out of it one after another, spin in alternate directions and fill the frame, then ease to a stop as a legible vortex that keeps turning.

beats.what: the wide logo is on screen from the first frame on a light disc that grows gently into place over the first second
a circle draws clockwise from 12 o'clock around the logo at a near-constant speed, easing only as it closes at 0.53 s
after a short breath on the finished mark, the first ring, the company name, fades in just outside the circle and starts spinning
a new ring arrives about every two thirds of a second, alternating tagline and name, each growing outward and turning opposite to its neighbour
the vortex fills past the frame edges and its growth begins to ease off
the rings have settled into a still vortex around the logo and keep turning gently to the end
